metadata.description:
A 5-step context learning workflow where a user progressively reveals
information about their organization. Tests the system's ability to
accumulate user context (organization type, country, sector, experience level)
and use that accumulated profile to provide personalized recommendations.
The scenario validates that the system remembers and applies user context
when suggesting funding calls and participation strategies.
